### The Law of Christ
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/law-christ
Passage: Galatians 6:2
Points:
- Walking in the Spirit calls believers into humble community rather than individualized isolation.
- Bearing burdens means stepping in when another person's load of illness, loneliness, or failure is too heavy to carry alone.
- Caring for suffering believers reflects Christ, who bore our griefs and weaknesses on the cross.
- Fulfilling the law of Christ means actively living out His ethical teaching through the Spirit's power.
- Christians must intentionally build close relationships so they can both share and receive support.

### Don’t Grow Weary Doing Good
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/dont-grow-weary-doing-good
Passage: Galatians 6:9
Points:
- Anyone committed to doing good will eventually face resistance and the temptation to grow weary.
- Overcoming fatigue begins with examining our motives to ensure we are genuinely serving others rather than self.
- We must look outside ourselves to Christ, who endured intense hostility and never grows faint.
- Enduring in good works requires clinging to God's promises rather than visible circumstances.
- Weariness often arises from our own impatience, but God promises a harvest at His appointed time.
